title: docs(skills): teach the stack's push block — direct transport, credentialRef only, relay not yet served
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DSNaEBXm47RQNvdu7w6Vook)_

Fixes #30092

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`objectstack-platform` 技能的运维参考页新增「Mobile push」一小节,讲清 stack 的 `push` 配置块怎么写;`SKILL.md` 里 `requires` 表的 `push` 那一格加了一个指向它的链接;#29969 那条推送 eval 用例补上 `transport: 'direct'` 与 `credentialRef` 的断言。
- **为什么改**:技能原先只说有 `push` 这个键,没教怎么填。AI 要给 `os serve` 开推送时会去猜配置、可能把 APNs/FCM 密钥直接写进配置,或选一个尚未上线的中继通道。
- **风险与回滚**:纯技能文档 + eval,`@objectstack/skills` patch;token 棘轮靠同文件删除重复内容付账(SKILL.md −2、operations.md −3),未抬任何上限。回滚即撤这一个 commit。
- **先看**:① `skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md` 新增的 `## Mobile push` 段;② 同文件里为付账删掉的两行「Common ops pitfalls」(与 Ports & networking 一节重复);③ `evals/config-plugins-ops.json` 第 12 条。
- **两分钟验证**:对照 `packages/spec/src/system/push-config.zod.ts` 与 `packages/services/service-push/src/capability-arg.ts`,确认今天只服务 `direct`、中继(含空 `{}`)启动即拒、密钥只经 `credentialRef`。
- **需要你做的**:`skills/**` 属 Tier H,需一位受管审批人(os-zhuang 或 hotlong)批准后合并。

## What changes

- `skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md` gains `## Mobile push`: `requires: ['push']` reads the top-level `push` key (`PushServiceConfigSchema`); the served transport today is `transport: 'direct'` only, one block per vendor, at least one (`apns`: `teamId`, `keyId`, `topic`, `environment`, `credentialRef`; `fcm`: `projectId`, `credentialRef`); `credentialRef` names each secret and never holds it, and an inline `privateKey` / `serviceAccount` / PEM / JSON value is refused; the relay transport (also what `{}` or an absent key reads as) is refused at boot until its sender ships (#29920, open).
- `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md`: the `requires` table's service row points `push` at that section (one pointer, no new line).
- `skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json` case 12 (#29969's): the expected output teaches the direct shape and the relay's status; `must_contain` gains `transport: 'direct'` and `credentialRef`, `must_not_contain` gains `serviceAccount:`. Case shape unchanged.
- `.changeset/30092-platform-skill-push-block.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`.

Facts read off `origin/main` `254f2ec1`: `packages/spec/src/system/push-config.zod.ts` (the schema, its `strictObject` guidance maps for inline secrets, `PushRelayTransportConfigSchema` marked `[PLANNED — not yet served]`), `packages/services/service-push/src/capability-arg.ts` (`resolvePushCapabilityArg` throws when `config.transport !== 'direct'`, absent and `{}` included) and `src/credential.ts` (open-tier resolver = environment variable named by the reference).

| `skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md` | 3119 | 3116 | 3119 |
| bundle total (whole shipped tree) | 226670 | 226666 | — |

Lines: `SKILL.md` 413 → 412; `operations.md` 199 → 212; all `SKILL.md` files summed 4523 → 4522.

Deleted restatement that paid for it:
- `operations.md`: the `os validate` row's list of the three gates (the Verify-your-work section right below lists them); the "Use `os validate` as the fast inner-loop check…" sentence (the code block's comments say it); "run the **same** structural + semantic gates" → "Both run the same gates"; the `os lint` aside's example list; two Common-ops-pitfalls rows (`Port N is already in use`, better-auth `Invalid origin` 403) that restate the Ports & networking section's production row and sync list.
- `SKILL.md`: the auth-callback example list in "`auth` implies `email`".

## Tests

Docs and eval fixture only; no code behaviour changes, so no ablation.

## Acceptance notes

- Kept to the file surface: `references/plugin-development.md` (held by PR #30726) and `packages/**` untouched.

## Verification
